components.name: Alert
components.description: Display a contextual message that requires user attention.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Display a small numeric or dot indicator to convey status or count information.

components.name: CircularProgress
components.description: Visualize numeric progress in a circular format.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.description: Request explicit user confirmation before performing a consequential action.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Display content in a side panel that slides in from the screen edge.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: Show a clear message when no data is available to display.

components.name: Modal
components.description: Display important content in a focused dialog window.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Visualize numeric progress as a linear bar.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Display a placeholder while content is loading.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Show indeterminate progress or loading activity.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Display a temporary notification message that auto-dismisses.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Display supplementary information when user hovers over an element.
